objective: Determine whether the exact layer-3 expert-103 rank-four down correction repeats its one-context KLD improvement on document-disjoint GLM-5.2 references while remaining smaller than the comparison tensors.
evidence_boundary: The registered candidate crossed the numerical KLD target on one context after its expert identity and rank were informed by that context. The registration freezes the candidate before independent evaluation; it does not claim document-level generalization, serialized checkpoint size, or production-runtime support.

base_representation.description: K3 gate and up encodes plus the earlier reconstructed-activation down refit, with source-target K3 down retained wherever that refit fell back

one_context_measurement.selection_bias: Rank four was tested on three expert identities chosen after rank-two KLD attribution on the same context. This context cannot be reused as independent confirmation evidence.

confirmation_contract.required_quality_decision: The 95% paired-bootstrap upper bound for candidate-minus-EXL3 document-mean KLD is below zero, and document-level CVaR1% is non-inferior within a margin frozen before access.
confirmation_contract.required_size_decision: A factor-aware serialized panel and complete checkpoint remain strictly smaller than the immutable EXL3 comparators after every stored byte is charged.
confirmation_contract.candidate_changes_after_registration: Any change creates a different candidate and requires a separate sealed confirmation set.
